description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Revised Code of Washington (RCW) — Washington state statutes — by citation. "RCW 9A.32.030" is first degree murder. Returns the statutory text and its heading. Keyless. Use for "what does RCW 46.61.502 say", "text of RCW 49.60.180", or to check a Washington statute a case relies on.
name: wa_rcw_section
title: Wa Rcw Section
